## About this dashboard
The Special Detailed Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with comprehensive, item-level prescribing data for advanced analysis. This report is designed for users who require a deeper understanding of prescribing patterns, costs, and trends beyond what standard dashboards offer. It includes detailed information such as BNF codes, prescriber details, dispensing dates, and geographical breakdowns, enabling users to create bespoke queries tailored to specific needs.

The report captures data processed by NHS Prescription Services for prescriptions dispensed in the community. It supports activities such as validating prescribing behaviour, monitoring compliance with clinical guidelines, and identifying anomalies or outliers that may require intervention. Users can filter data by time periods, therapeutic categories, and organisational levels, making it a versatile tool for commissioners, analysts, and medicines optimisation teams.

The aim of the Special Detailed Report is to provide transparency and flexibility for in-depth analysis, supporting financial accountability and clinical governance. While highly detailed, it should not be used in isolation but alongside other dashboards and reports to provide context and inform strategic decisions. Its intention is to help generate discussion within local health economies, identify areas for improvement, and share best practice across organisations.
